title: 30-day Launch Tactical Briefing & KPI Thermostat
body:
Purpose
This is a short tactical brief for the next 30 days around the canary and early-scale phases. Focus is on three operational goals: protecting latency SLOs, keeping token cost within budget, and maintaining a smooth canary to 5% traffic expansion. This doc is intended to be a lightweight ops guide for the launch commander and the rotation of owners.

High level launch goals (30 day window)
- Day 0 to 3: stabilization and smoke validation with beta cohort (internal + 50 external testers).
- Day 4 to 14: phased canary 0.5% -> 1% -> 2% -> 5% if signals stable.
- Day 15 to 30: ramp to target cohort and monitor 7x24 for anomalies.

Primary KPIs and targets
- P90 latency: target <= 250ms (green), 250-400ms (yellow), >400ms (red).
- Error rate (server 5xx + infra timeouts): green <0.3%, yellow 0.3-1.0%, red >1.0%.
- Cost per 1k tokens served: target <= 0.30 USD, yellow 0.30-0.45, red >0.45.
- Cache hit rate (prefix/KV): target >= 45%, yellow 30-44%, red <30%.
- User facing correctness regression rate from eval set: green <1.0% regressions, yellow 1-3%, red >3%.

KPI Thermostat logic (quick primer)
- Green zone: proceed with next traffic expansion step. No immediate action other than continued monitoring.
- Yellow zone: pause traffic expansion, throttle to previous stable percentage, trigger focused triage with owners listed below, increase logging and retain traces.
- Red zone: immediate rollback to safe model variant or previous stable route, trigger oncall escalation, spin up contingency capacity if needed.

Week by week forecast (operational planner)
- Week 1 (D0-7): Expected requests 75k; target latency P90 180-220ms; cache hit 50%; cost per 1k tokens 0.27 USD. Owners: infra lead, runtime, product-ops.
- Week 2 (D8-14): Expected requests 220k; P90 target 200-250ms; cache hit 46%; cost per 1k tokens 0.28 USD. Owners: serving-runtime, observability.
- Week 3 (D15-21): Expected requests 650k; P90 target 220-300ms; cache hit 44%; cost per 1k tokens 0.31 USD. Owners: hosting, product ops.
- Week 4 (D22-30): Expected requests 1.1M; P90 target 250ms; cache hit 45%; cost per 1k tokens 0.29 USD. Owners: cross-functional.

Readiness checklist (pre traffic expansion)
- Monitoring: dashboards for latency, error rate, cost per token, cache hit rate, and model quality. Owner: Rina. Status: done for latency and errors, cost dashboard in progress.
- Alerting: pager thresholds mapped to thermostat zones. Owner: Ethan. Status: done but need fine tuning for 10% traffic burst.
- Rollouts: canary config and automatic fallback configured in console. Owner: Liam. Status: ready in staging, pending small-run verification.
- Instrumentation: distributed tracing across API -> routing -> runtime; token level costing tags enabled. Owner: infra. Status: partial, tracing missing on fallback path.
- Customer comms: beta cohort email and runtime expectations note prepared. Owner: product-ops. Status: draft.

Runbook snippets (for quick use)
- If error rate enters yellow for 10 minutes: pause rollout, set canary to previous traffic %, open triage channel #launch-thermostat, collect last 200 traces, assign incident lead.
- If latency enters red for 5 minutes and sustained: switch routing policy to nearest lower-cost variant with identical token semantics, notify oncall SRE, enable burst capacity policy if autoscaling insufficient.
- If cost per 1k tokens spikes into red: enable quantization profile auto-fallback and increase batching window for non-interactive routes, notify finance lead for budget notification.

Owner matrix (primary contacts)
- Launch commander: Maya Rivera
- Serving runtime lead: Liam O'Connor
- Infra and scaling: Ethan Park
- Observability: Rina Gupta
- Product ops coordinator: Maya Rivera
- Support escalation point: Priya Nair (CS)

Communication plan
- T minus 30m: short briefing to slack #launch-ops and @launch-commander
- T plus 5m: quick health snapshot to huddle channel #launch-thermostat
- Hourly after expansion: automated KPI digest to product-ops and oncall
- Incident: use incident template PRODOPS-482 and create a postmortem draft within 48 hours

Open questions and notes to self
- Validate fallback model variants are functionally compatible for 3 languages we ship. Action: Liam to confirm by D-1.
- Need a small synthetic test for token billing correlation to real traffic. Action: Ethan to define test by D0.
- Consider temporary increase in KV cache memory on dedicated pools if hit rate drops below 35% during ramp. Cost impact to be estimated.

Links and quick refs
- Playbook root: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/launch-playbook
- Incident template: PRODOPS-482
- Infra PR for autoscale tweaks: GH-rr/infra#128

Appendix: quick shortcode for thermostat decisions
- GO: all primary KPIs in green for 30m following expansion window
- PAUSE: any single critical KPI in yellow for 15m or two non critical KPIs in yellow for 30m
- ROLLBACK: any critical KPI in red for 5m or sustained cost red for 30m

End notes
- This doc is intentionally lean. Use linked artifacts for detailed checklists and ticket trackers. Keep this sheet pinned during the first 72 hours and let the telemetry drive the expansion cadence.
- Last updated by Maya Rivera on 2026-01-17.
